about: The native-mac suite's expected differences (docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-18-own-native-engine-design.md, Verification system part 3; Acceptance 6), read by `node scripts/repl-parity.mjs diff <vendor-run> <cua-run> --expected scripts/repl-parity/expected/native-mac.json` (scripts/repl-parity/native-mac-diff.mjs). Every difference between the vendor engine's accessibility text and cua's on the four scenes is declared here with its cause, in the vendor-defects style (scripts/repl-parity/vendor-defects.mjs): an observation of the pinned vendor or of the scene, never a skip. `scene` is textedit, finder, chrome, electron or *; `golden` is full (the fixed state), before (the action's first observation), diff (the observation right after the action) or settle (the observation two seconds later), one or a list, all three text goldens when absent; `fault` is "vendor" (the pinned vendor's own defect: cua's output is the right one), "scene state" (the two lanes' actions left different states) or "departure" (cua's declared difference from the vendor, with `decisionLog` citing its entry by its dated opening); an engine or renderer fault of cua's is a defect to fix, never a declaration. Kinds and their fields are the renderer goldens' (test/native-goldens/expected.json): `missing` and `added` (a whole line by its matching `head`: role word, flags and title, then ` | ` and the labels), `part` (inside a matched line, cua's `<label>: <cua>` is the vendor's `<label>: <vendor>`), `header` and `trailer` (both sides' exact text), `lineBreaks` (cua's departure of printing an attribute's line breaks escaped: `scene` *, no count, never over-declared; on a matched line or a focused-element trailer, the vendor's text with its breaks escaped as cua's renderer escapes them is cua's), `subsetCount` (the vendor's `(showing <ranges> of <N> items)` on the element whose `ID:` is `identifier` is min(cua's N, `cap`)), `addedOverTenPercent` (`decisionLog`), and `settle` (`lane`: the engine whose observation moved in the two seconds after the action). `count` is exact (default 1); a declaration nothing needed is itself a difference. The entries below are the ones the renderer goldens' recording (test/native-goldens/expected.json, the M1b closing wave) shows apply to the suite's cells, which are the goldens' own cells on the same scenes; the first full run on the mini (M2b.5) confirms each or reports it overdeclared.

declarations.cause: Vendor defect, declared for the renderer goldens by the spec's Decision Log "M1b closing wave" item 1c: the vendor's subset count of the run's file list reads `of 100 items` where cua reads the true count. availableSubsetDescription (0x10063e220) counts the element's childCount through get_childCount (0x10079e94c), over the hierarchy its prefetch read with _AXUIElementCopyHierarchy with AXChildren capped at MaxArrayCount 100 (docs/doperpowers/research/2026-10-18-own-native-engine/F-helper-logic.md §1 item 1), so its N never exceeds 100. cua keeps the true count: a model looking for item 150 must not be told the list ends at 100. Only N may differ; the visible ranges and the rest of the line must match.

declarations.cause: Scene state, not rendering (carried from the renderer goldens' recording, test/native-goldens/expected.json): the vendor's click on the document's first line scrolled the document to its end (the vertical scroll bar and its indicator 0.02 → 1, its diff's only two lines), while cua's click left the tree unchanged, so cua answers the no-change sentence. The vendor activates TextEdit on a click (#162); cua does not.

cua's departure (ruling 1175): the vendor prints an attribute's line breaks raw (its TextEdit document value, and the flattened title, description and value it joins with "\n" in flattenedString 0x10063eb80, such as Finder's "go up" row), so a page or a document could put a line into the tree that reads as an element, a prompt-injection path. cua's renderer prints each break escaped (src/services/engine/render.mjs escapeLineBreaks: LF and CR as \n and \r, as the vendor's Linux rendering does, every other break as \uXXXX). On a matched line or a focused-element trailer, the vendor's text with its breaks escaped so is cua's; anything else there stays a difference. A rule, not an instance: no count.
